meta.name: Madam Inspector
meta.description: When brides preparing to remarry begin dying in eerily similar ways, Inspector Chitra races to find the hidden link connecting their deaths.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Sub-inspector Chitra Basu suspects murder in a bride's death, but senior officers insist it's just a case of suicide.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Chitra is suspended while probing the case, but another bride's death in the same manner raises new doubts.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A special team is formed to catch the serial killer, and Chitra is brought back to join the investigation.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Chitra crosses paths with Chirayu at a wedding. She soon suspects similar murders are happening in other religions.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Chitra and her husband are attacked, the murderer manages to escape before being caught.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The police link Chirayu to the murders, but there's no evidence. Their search leads to an old woman instead.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: In the final showdown, Chitra sets a trap for the real killer, risking her sister's life in the process.
